sources.title: 10 Hugging Face Models Worth Knowing in 2026 - KDnuggets
sources.snippet: The Hugging Face Hub reached nearly 3 million public model repositories in mid-2026, up from 2.43 million at the start of the year. For practitioners, the challenge is no longer access. It's knowing which models are worth your time, which have been superseded, and which are running in production pipelines regardless of what the benchmarks say.
